messages:
Maya: Quick draft for a compact onboarding pulse for trial signups — 3 emails over 7 days. Goal = drive activation (first API call) and surface upgrade triggers. Thinking small, measurable, and easy to iterate.
Ethan: love the short series. do we have a target activation metric? :chart_with_upwards_trend:
Maya: target = 40% first-api-call within 7 days for recipients who opened >=1 email. baseline is ~22% currently.
Priya: can we micro-segment by initial usage signal? e.g., no API calls vs 1-5 calls vs >5 calls
Maya: yes. plan: three slices
- "cold": no API calls in first 48h -> emphasis on quickstart + one-click examples
- "warm": 1-5 calls -> show batching/embedding tips + case study
- "active": >5 calls -> upgrade path + cost/throughput benefits (Dedicated / Private)
Jordan: subjectline ideas? keeping them short for mobile
- Cold A: "Start generating in 5 minutes — starter guide"
- Cold B: "Your Redwood trial — quickstart inside"
- Warm A: "Save tokens — smarter batching tips"
- Warm B: "Get more throughput for less"
- Active A: "Scale with reserved capacity — save on cost"
Camille: thumbs on A/B for cold & warm. for active maybe single focused CTA to book demo or view pricing
Maya: timeline: send1=day0 (signup), send2=day2, send3=day6. If user activates before send2 => skip send2 and send a tailored "thanks" variant on day6.
Ethan: can we wire this into inbound routing so SDRs get a flag for high-usage trialers? ideally a Slack pings
Maya: yes — propose rule: if calls >50 in 48h OR token usage >100k -> tag as "trial-hot" and send a daily digest to #sales-trial-hot. cc: eng-bench-bot will attach usage snapshot.
Priya: need copy notes for each slice. quick drafts:
- Cold email 1: "Start your first call — 3 lines to get you going" + one code block
- Warm email 2: "Batching + caching tips" + link to short blog + benchmark GIF
- Active email 3: "Upgrading to Dedicated" + pricing CTA
Maya: code snippet for quickstart (in email) — short inline:
```
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $API_KEY" \
  -d '{"model":"redwood-1-small","input":"Hello"}'
```
Camille: that snippet is perfect. keep HTML fallback so it's clickable in mobile.
Jordan: A/B measurement plan: open rate, click-to-activate, activation conversion, upgrade intent (pricing page view or contact). Run A/B for subjectlines only for first two sends. N=2k per arm for stat power.
Ethan: where do we keep the creative? share a sheet and assets here pls
Maya: sheet: https://docs.google.com/spreadsheets/d/1EXAMPLE (column: slice, subject_A, subject_B, preheader, body, link, gif)
Priya: also adding segmentation mapping to Braze/Hub rules. will add routing rule snippet in sheet. small example rule for router:
```
if (user.calls_last_48h == 0) send(campaign_cold)
else if (user.calls_last_48h <= 5) send(campaign_warm)
else send(campaign_active)
```
eng-bench-bot: usage snapshot attached for users flagged as trial-hot (sample). CSV export link will be posted to the sheet hourly.
Camille: ask: should we include a short micro-survey in email3 asking "what's blocking you?" (1-click options)
Jordan: yes — helps sales discovery and content iteration. keep optional, one-click responses.
Maya: next steps: Priya to prod copy + variants by EOD Thu, Jordan to set experiment flags & sample size, Ethan to wire Slack routing + sample digest, Camille to prepare creative assets (1 GIF, 2 screenshots). I'll schedule a 30m sync Fri if needed.
Ethan: ok will add router rule in infra ticket #4567 and cc sales
Priya: adding copy to sheet now
Maya: sweet. thanks team :rocket:
